digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud and Data Center) reconciler test harness
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) has production-hardened test coverage from incidents while Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) lacks equivalent characterization pins for field values, sanitizer boundaries, and create-path branches
Data Center adapter has untested multi-page pagination and rate-limiting handling that Cloud adapter lacks, creating asymmetric confidence in the two adapters sharing the same backend port
DC comment and description length-convergence behavior has never been pinned by value and relies on unverified constants rather than observed contract assertions
Ticket-type field mapping is duplicated across adapters and must be single-sourced with a guard preventing re-duplication, similar to existing status and priority map guards
Five enumerated test cases lack meaningful assertions and either assert their named contract or must be renamed to reflect what they actually pin, rather than being deleted
Cloud adapter's whole-project readers have never been tested against pagination beyond one page, creating an untested operational edge that mirrors DC's pagination complexity
